notes.title: Updated Lighting System, Audio and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A random update for Consequence. I have been working on the sequel and other games, along with updating this one. After testing, this update is stable for release, so enjoy! The update aims to improve the lighting so the game looks less paper like, along with adding bloom to the lights, fixing one of the achievements that doesn't work for some players, along with changing some of the music to correctly fit with the theme of the scene. Patch notes below, thank you as always!

Noodle :)

Patch Notes v1.2.1.2:

- Added post-processing effects (including bloom, vignette and more)
- Changed the first storm scene and the cave scene to have more ambient music
- Killing all the sad men in the game is no longer impossible for some players.
